description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pantheon''' braces his shield in the target direction and [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channels]] for 1.5 seconds, during which he becomes [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerable]] to non-[[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turret]] damage dealt by enemies from the target direction. He also continually performs strikes in a cone in front of him, dealing 8.3% AD physical damage every 0.125 seconds to enemies hit, reduced by 50% against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and up to 100% AD '''total''' physical damage.
description.text: Active: Pantheon braces his shield in the target direction and channels for 1.5 seconds, during which he becomes invulnerable to non- turret damage dealt by enemies from the target direction. He also continually performs strikes in a cone in front of him, dealing 8.3% AD physical damage every 0.125 seconds to enemies hit, reduced by 50% against minions and up to 100% AD total physical damage.

description2.raw: ''Aegis Assault'' can be recast after 0.3 seconds, and does so automatically after the duration. ''Aegis Assault's'' channel cannot be [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]] by [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]].
description2.text: Aegis Assault can be recast after 0.3 seconds, and does so automatically after the duration. Aegis Assault's channel cannot be interrupted by crowd control.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Pantheon''' slams with his shield in a cone in front of him, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.
description3.text: Recast: Pantheon slams with his shield in a cone in front of him, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

description4.text: Mortal Will: After recasting, Pantheon gains 5 – 32.94 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 2.5% bonus health)  bonus armor and  bonus magic resistance for 4 seconds as well as  60% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds.

notes.text:
Deals persistent area damage for the continuous strikes and area damage with the slam.
The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
* Recasting the ability manually does not.
Pantheon retains his invulnerability during the recast's cast time.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
* Pantheon will slam from wherever he was at the start of the recast's' cast time.
Spell shield will only block the slam's damage.
